Much like on a submarine, or a climate-controlled laboratory, clean airflow isn't just a matter of comfort, it's an important part of keeping both the crew and the Station running smoothly. Science, operations, exercise... our days on the International Space Station are busy and maintenance is part of the routine too. Everyone gets their share of housekeeping duties! -- Jour 222, orbite 3442 – Encore une séquence d’aspirateur dans l’espace ! Dans un environnement comme le notre, où l’air est continuellement recyclé dans un système presque en circuit fermé, il est absolument essentiel de garder les grilles de ventilation propres.
